s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate
salient_findings: Erythematous papules with crusts and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip with sparing of the surrounding skin
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis, erosions, and nodular lymphocyte infiltrate
Biopsy results showed CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin condition with erythematous papules and lymphoid infiltrate
salient_findings: Erythematous papules with crusts and excoriations on the trunk and upper extremities
Scales and fissures on the lower lip with sparing of the surrounding skin
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis, erosions, and nodular lymphocyte infiltrate
Biopsy results showed CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.rationale: The presence of erythematous papules, crusts, and excoriations, along with the skin biopsy results showing spongiosis, erosions, and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate with CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells, are consistent with mycosis fungoides, a type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: atopic dermatitis
rejected.why: The lack of response to topical corticosteroids and the presence of a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate on biopsy are not typical of atopic dermatitis.

rejected.label: dermatitis
rejected.why: The term dermatitis is too broad and does not account for the specific biopsy findings and delayed erythema to UV-A.

rejected.label: eczema
rejected.why: Eczema is a general term that encompasses several conditions, including atopic dermatitis, and does not explain the specific biopsy results and phototest findings.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: The biopsy results did not show non-caseating granulomas, which are characteristic of sarcoidosis.
